	1. Name: Satoshi | Rating: 5
Honda engines have been an absolute dream for decades! Living in Germany, I can attest to the outstanding quality of these engines; they reliably do their job and stand for quality and performance like few other brands. My wife and I are absolutely thrilled with the design of the new Prelude! A masterpiece of form—fantastic. A dream car. I hope that one day we’ll be able to afford this car, even if it might take a long time given the high inflation here in Germany and the fact that we are currently caring for a family member with serious health needs, making things difficult right now. We saw this model in person and were blown away! It is currently one of the most beautiful road-legal cars out there. I’ve loved Honda cars since I was a small child, and Honda motorcycles are of excellent quality too—just think of the old and new Rebel models; fantastic bikes! You do amazing work, and my wife, my children, and I want to offer you our highest praise for being a part of our lives for decades 🙏🏻 Thank you, Honda, for top-notch work 🔥 Greetings with Love and Respect from Germany 🙏🏻

	2. Name: Grant Wroe | Rating: 4
The time I went there was only the ground floor available for viewing so please check the website to see what's going on. There were vehicles outside that you could view but unfortunately it was a bit of a letdown but that's just down to my error.
The imperial Park across the road from it is Handy but make sure you can view this as this was also closed off to the public but back open in  April

	3. Name: Faisal Khan | Rating: 1
I have been trying to reach out to you guys but it seems like there is no email address mentioned anywhere, my issue is simple, I purchased a Car and an issue arises in it.

Following the normal procedure I made a complaint, the company said yes we will replace the part. Now its been three months already and the company is saying you may need to wait till April 2026 and its not confirmed that you will get the part replaced even at that time.

Regardless of how good the car is, once an issue arise, the company is known for its after sales services. Do you seriously assume that waiting for 7 Months to get one suspension part replaced is a justified timeline in any way?

Pathetic services. You really need to change your management.

	4. Name: M Faizal Ariffin | Rating: 1
Having previously driven the Honda Concerto, Fit, Civic and Vezel without issues, I am disappointed at the quality issues with my current HRV (2021 model).

With Honda cars it seems that all is good when the car has no issue.  But if we are unlucky enough to get a problematic build, Honda will not go the extra mile to support the authorized distributor to resolve it.

The reason provided for not being able to solve the rattling sound coming from the engine is: "there's no technical fault code or error hence not enough data to support".

Unfortunately customer driving experience is not important to Honda at all.  There are many moving parts and issues that sensors are not available and/or able to detect and capture technical data.  It doesn't mean the issue doesn't exist.

Next car will definitely not be a Honda.

	5. Name: Arkadiusz Goszczak | Rating: 5
The Honda HQ is just the HQ offices. There are no exhibits, nothing to see. The exhibition was at the Honda welcome plaza which is permanently closed for rebuilding.
